digest.component_or_area: LLM verdict signing and provenance tracking
propositions: Signed gate verdicts currently record only a model string and cannot distinguish between verdicts from different providers, endpoints, or tiers (first-class vs best-effort).

A new additive `provider_provenance` object must be stamped into verdicts containing provider, model, endpoint_host, tier, and effective capabilities, without modifying the existing model field or requiring a compatibility gate.

The provider_provenance record must be assembled in capabilities.py from primitives (provider, model, base_url, capabilities) maintaining the module's leaf invariant, and threaded through runner.py reusing the once-computed capability record.
Endpoint credentials from base_url (userinfo) must never appear in the persisted sidecar payload; only hostname extraction via urlparse().hostname is acceptable.

The provider_provenance must flow through finalize_verdict in all three gates (plan-review, completion, code-review) by threading the runner-assembled record from step outputs, not by recomputation or synthesizing from config.
